# F2 Douyin runtime subset

Upstream: Johnserf-Seed/f2 at f6be8c0ffba9a127075bbeafe4838716650b6325, version 0.0.1.7, Apache-2.0. Original LICENSE retained.

This includes Bili's Douyin model/signing/endpoint/configuration import closure and compiled translations. Python contents are unchanged; unused CLI/platform/database/downloader modules are omitted. Library packaging metadata is reduced and unrelated platform configuration removed. Bili owns networking, credentials, output selection, downloads and queues.

Original source: https://github.com/Johnserf-Seed/f2/tree/f6be8c0ffba9a127075bbeafe4838716650b6325
